page.layout: One page of running text in a single column. Line numbers (5, 10, 15, 20, 25) stand in the right margin beside the text. Below the last full line a word broken at the line end stands at the right as a catchword. Running head at the top, page number at the top left.

p.i: Gen.17.v.11. Fœdus meum erit in carne vestrâ.

main_text.p: In his locutionibus nomina rerum significatarum ipsis signis attribuuntur.5
a) conueniunt nucleo, qui est Christus.
a) 1. Iohan.1.v.7. Sanguis Iefu Christi Filij eius purgat nos ab omni peccato.10
Matth.26.v.26. Hoc est corpus meum. Et v.28. Hoc est sanguis meus.
b) Rom.10.v.17. Fides est ex auditu, auditus autem per verbum Dei.
Etc.4.vers.11. Signum accepit circumcifionis, sigillum iusti-tiafiaei[?].15
7. Verbum in sacramentis est concionale, & pro-inde ratione credentium est practicum seu efficax, ratione incredulorum est inefficax.20
2.Rom.2.v.25.& seqq. Circumcifio quidem prodest, si legem exequaris, &c. quòd si transgressor legis fueris, circumcifio tua fa-cta est præputium, &c.
1.Petri 3.v.21. Cui rei nunc correspondens exemplar baptismi nos quoque seruat (non quo carnis sordes abijciuntur, sed stipula-tio bonæ conscientiæ apud Deum) per resurrectionem Iefu Christi.25

2.Cor.2.v.15.16. Christi bona fragrantia sumus Deo, in iis qui seruantur, & in iis qui pereunt. His quidem odor mortis ad mortem: illis vero odor vitæ ad vitam. Confer 1.Cor.10.v.5. Sed plerofque illorum non approbauit Deus: eos videlicet qui escam spiritualem non rectè verâ fide sumserunt, &c.30

8. In sacramenti administratione sunt distinguenda ista sex: homo exterior dispensans & accipiens sacramentum, res terrestris, & actio circa rem terrestrem; quæ tria sunt externa: tum homo interior, res cœlestis seu tota

page.notes: The running text is set in a single column with a catchword at the foot. The line numbers in the right margin are read as 5, 10, 15, 20, 25, 30 from the scan; the one beside "tiafiaei" and the one beside "Petri" are not clearly legible, and the numbers 15 and 20 are doubtful. The word "tiafiaei" at the end of the line after "iusti-" is uncertain and is marked [?]. The Greek-free page has no reference marks in the text. Long s has been written as plain s throughout.
